roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Retention (5M to 50M users)

bullets: Insatiable learner: You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever craft or goal you’ve set your mind to.
Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.
Tenacious: You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.
Sense of urgency: You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.
0-to-1 scope : The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.
